items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: In fact, Miles asked me to play with him two or three times when he had Coltrane there, but I wouldn’t play with Miles

ctx.x: You’ve been doing that for 20 years or so.
Yes. Eddie was a good songwriter, too. He wrote a couple of songs that Miles stole and put his name on.
